changesApplied.changeMade: Created production environment configuration with Istio service mesh settings, resource limits, autoscaling, security contexts, and persistence configs

deploymentInstructions.local: helmfile sync  # Uses local environment by default (docker-desktop context)
deploymentInstructions.production: helmfile -e production --kube-context prod-cluster sync  # Explicitly select production
deploymentInstructions.verify: kubectl get virtualservices,destinationrules -n metabob  # Check Istio resources
deploymentInstructions.drift_resolution: helmfile sync  # Will update metabob-rpc-api from 0.12.5 to 0.12.6

antipatternPrevention.enforcement: All changes made via Helm/Helmfile. No direct kubectl modifications used
antipatternPrevention.validation: Documentation still forbids kubectl antipatterns. All resources managed by Helm
